_note: Synthetic demo identities. In production these come from your identity provider (SSO / JWT claims), never from the question text.

users.about: Supervisor officer, West. Sees West rows only; customer PII masked.
Supervisor officer, East. Sees East rows only; customer PII masked.
Sales rep R-E-03. Sees only the customers assigned to him (and their orders); first name, last initial and city.
HQ analyst. All regions; customer PII masked. Approves exports and glossary changes.

Agency contractor. No row-level customer or order data: monthly aggregates only, minimum group size 10.
